entries.en: what? how? what is it?
entries.notes: 原件R栏空缺；H「奈何」偏「如何、怎么办」，与L「que cosa」略偏，依M「may ho」定夺

entries.en: what is it? what thing?
pray tell; what is your instruction?
entries.notes: L仅作「que?」，语义依H「見教」（谦辞）补足

entries.en: what is it? what business?
entries.notes: H「亚」为语前助词（a-），「也」借作「乜」；L「negocio」（事务）与H相合

entries.en: a certain matter; some business
entries.notes: M栏「quia」（件）标记T99污损难辨，且L「que?」与H「某件事」不完全对应

entries.en: affair; matter; business
entries.notes: L「que?」属泛问，H「事路」为名词性答语，依H、M定夺

entries.en: how many? how much?
entries.notes: L「que?」为泛问，H「幾」与M「xoa」（joā）明指问数量

entries.en: what do you want? what is the matter?

entries.zh: 有什么见教？（问对方来意）
entries.en: what would you have me do? what is your wish?
entries.notes: L「quieri」为「quieres」旧拼；H「有是也見教」即「有乜见教」

entries.en: ah! oh! (exclamation given in reply)
entries.notes: L「respondiendo」标明此为答语；H「嗳亚」记感叹声

entries.en: what sin have you committed?
entries.notes: L「fez?/?hechos?」残缺；H「靠」疑为「過」（罪過），与M「goe cua」相合

entries.zh: 是什么城里人？（问籍贯、身份）
entries.en: what city is this man from? of what standing?
entries.notes: L「calidad」与H「城人」不合，疑原文作「ciudad」；L另有「?」残损标记

entries.en: what day? on which day?
entries.notes: H「值」借作「佇」（tī，在），与M「ry chit xit」相合

entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L「?an ?rables?」大面积残损，H「幾却」与M「xoa quep」不能成义，仅存「幾」（问数）线索

entries.en: what to do? what are you doing?
what can you do to me?
entries.notes: H「杂」形近「奈」，M「nay」可证；L「meade」即「me ha de」

entries.en: what is there to know? what do you know?
entries.notes: M「ban」与「識」（bat/sek）对音不合，疑抄写之误，依L、H定夺

entries.en: your birth date / horoscope (year and month of birth)

entries.zh: 执事；承办此事（听候吩咐）
entries.en: to attend to the matter; at your service (what do you command?)
entries.notes: L「vm.」即vuestra merced；H「執事」取「任事、承办」义

entries.en: what objection is there? why not?
